title: What did Jesus actually look like?

beats.text: Jesus did not look like your painting.
beats.scene: Painted portrait hall of pale European Jesus images fading into a dark-skinned Galilean carpenter at sunset. Overlay: crossed-out frame.

beats.text: The Gospels never describe his face.
beats.scene: Open scroll of the Gospels in lamplight with a blank space. Overlay: none.

beats.text: So in 2001, forensic expert Richard Neave rebuilt one.
beats.scene: Forensic artist sculpting clay over a skull in a lab. Overlay: date badge 2001.

beats.text: He used a first-century skull from the region.
beats.scene: Ancient skull on a lab table, warm lamplight. Overlay: date badge 1st century.

beats.text: The face is broad, with dark skin, dark eyes and short hair.
beats.scene: Clay reconstruction of a weathered Semitic face in side light. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Paul even writes that long hair is shameful for a man.
beats.scene: Man at a village well with short dark hair, dusk. Overlay: quote marker only.

beats.text: He likely stood about one point five five metres, around fifty kilograms.
beats.scene: Galilean man standing in a doorway at sunrise. Overlay: scale bar 1.66 m, weight badge 50 kg.
beats.source: Joe Zias estimate for 1st-century Judean men

beats.text: Compare yourself: probably taller, and heavier.
beats.scene: Silhouette of a modern person next to a first-century man at dusk. Overlay: side-by-side height compare.

beats.text: Why no description? The Gospels care about words, not looks.
beats.scene: Disciples listening to a preacher on a hillside at sunset. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Not proven: this is an average face, not his face.
beats.scene: Rows of clay faces in a workshop, one lit. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: The real answer: a working man of Galilee.
beats.scene: Carpenter planing wood in a sunlit workshop. Overlay: none.

beats.text: So what did Jesus look like: your painting, or an ordinary Galilean?
beats.scene: Painted close-up of a calm weathered face at sunset, slow push in. Overlay: choice tags A painting / B ordinary.

youtube.title: What Did Jesus Actually Look Like? #shorts
youtube.description:
The Gospels never describe Jesus's face. A 2001 forensic reconstruction suggests a very different look from paintings.
It is an educated guess, not his actual face.
#Jesus #Bible #BibleHistory #History
